correctness.rationale: The unique interior zero follows from the strict minimum-modulus root of 1+w+...+w^(n-1)=C_n. The projection formula produces a nonzero harmonic Bergman eigenfunction with the sole pole removed; the essential-spectrum result proves separation. The boundary point is explicitly aligned with the eigenvalue, giving exact (not just lower-bound) distance. A one-critical-point derivative proves the unique maximum. The geometric-sum equation gives the stated threshold asymptotics. Actual packaged checker passes supplementary root, gap and finite Toeplitz-residual checks; finite checks are not infinite proofs.

value.rationale: An explicit n-1-point isolated spectrum provides a linearly growing constructive lower bound alongside the recently established exponential upper bound for degree n polynomial symbols. The degree-independent two-term symbol family makes the inverse spectral count and separation natural rather than ad hoc. The exact optimizer of essential-spectral distance and its n/(6e) asymptotic quantitatively determine robust spectral isolation at high degree. This is a structural sharp classification of a natural eigenvalue branch, not a table lookup or routine improvement.
